title: Microsoft Teams: tenant meeting policy for who can start recording and transcription
summary: The briefing's policy behaviour, default and rollout dates are supported by Microsoft's notice and the roadmap; the existing controls and licensing statements are supported by Microsoft Learn. The sensitivity-label path has a minor omission of a wizard page heading, already named in its accompanying note.

claims.claim: Microsoft plans a Teams meeting policy controlling who can start recording and transcription.
claims.quote: Teams administrators can use meeting policies to control who can start recording and transcription, helping organizations apply consistent meeting settings.

claims.where: summary; What's changing; Risk assessment; Scope; rationale: impact
claims.claim: The planned policy can restrict recording and transcription to organisers and co-organisers or extend permission to presenters.
claims.quote: Administrators can restrict these permissions to organizers and co-organizers or extend them to presenters.

claims.where: summary; What's changing; Why it matters; Risk assessment; rationale: impact
claims.claim: Administrators can allow organisers to change the role selection or enforce it so organisers cannot change it.
claims.quote: When organizer changes are blocked, Meeting options shows the policy value as read-only with a notice that it is locked by meeting policy.

claims.where: summary; What's changing; Governance guidance; Governance controls; controls[0].note
claims.claim: Microsoft Learn does not yet describe the newly announced tenant policy at the time of writing in November 2026.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams tenant policy "Who can record and transcribe" "Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy" licensing. Read meeting-recording, manage-meeting-recording-options, meeting-templates-sensitivity-labels-policies and Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy; none describes the new policy.

claims.where: What's changing; Why it matters; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Learn documents the existing organiser choice between organisers and co-organisers and organisers, co-organisers and presenters.
claims.quote: Meeting organizer can choose who can record—Organizers and co-organizers or Organizers, co-organizers, and presenters—unless the setting is enforced by a label or template.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment; Governance guidance; controls[3].governs
claims.claim: A meeting template can enforce who can record in meetings using that template.
claims.quote: If not controlled by a sensitivity label, selects a setting of Organizers and co-organizers or Organizers, co-organizers, and presenters. Setting can be enforced or meeting organizer can be allowed to change.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment; Governance guidance; controls[4].governs
claims.claim: A sensitivity label can enforce the recording and transcription role restriction for meetings carrying that label.
claims.quote:
Meeting settings that you can apply with a sensitivity label:

- Who can bypass the lobby
- Who can present
- Who can record and transcribe

claims.claim: The existing Learn guidance says there is no admin policy for Who can record, unlike the new policy announced in Message Center.
claims.quote: Meeting recording can be disabled completely using a meeting policy, but there's no admin policy for Who can record.

claims.claim: The existing Meeting recording policy toggle allows or prevents recording rather than selecting recording roles within a meeting.
claims.quote:
To allow or prevent meeting recordings, follow these steps:
1. In the left navigation of the Teams admin center, go to Meetings > Meeting policies.

claims.claim: Existing recording and transcription behaviour remains unchanged when administrators do not configure the new policy.

claims.quote: A sensitivity label that configures this option takes precedence over the meeting policy.

claims.claim: A locked meeting policy takes precedence over a meeting template.
claims.quote: A locked meeting policy takes precedence over a meeting template. An unlocked policy supplies a default.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: Learn describes private-meeting recordings as uploaded to the organiser's OneDrive.
claims.quote: It gets uploaded to the meeting organizer's OneDrive (private meetings) or SharePoint (channel meetings).

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: Channel-meeting recordings are stored in SharePoint.
claims.quote: It gets uploaded to the meeting organizer's OneDrive (private meetings) or SharePoint (channel meetings).

claims.claim: The organiser needs recording permission under the existing recording policy.
claims.quote: Both the organizer and recording initiator need to have recording permissions to record the meeting or event.

claims.claim: The person initiating recording also needs recording permission.
claims.quote: Both the organizer and recording initiator need to have recording permissions to record the meeting or event.

claims.claim: The announcement describes control of who may initiate recording and transcription, not a feature that autonomously starts either.
claims.quote: Teams administrators can use a policy to configure who may start recording and transcription.

claims.claim: Learn states that when organisers turn off Microsoft Copilot in Teams meetings and events, recording and transcription are also turned off.
claims.quote: When organizers turn off Microsoft Copilot in Teams meetings and events, recording and transcription are also turned off.

claims.claim: The new policy remains subject to existing recording and transcription availability controls and any sensitivity label configuring the option.
claims.quote: These configurations remain subject to existing recording and transcription availability controls and any sensitivity label that configures this option.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: Each user in the organisation needs a Teams licence to use Teams, except for joining meetings anonymously.
claims.quote: Except for joining Teams meetings anonymously, each user in your organization must have a Teams license before they can use Teams.

claims.claim: No price specific to the new meeting policy has been published.
claims.quote: Searched: "Teams" "tenant policy" "record and transcribe" price. Read user-access and meeting-recording; examined Premium overview and recording-transcription-overview search excerpts, the roadmap and MC1560924. None gives a price or meter for this new policy.

claims.claim: The new control is admin-opt-in in the sense that it imposes no new restriction until administrators configure it.
claims.quote: No action is required. If you do not configure the new policy, existing recording and transcription behavior remains unchanged.

claims.claim: The licensing model is included under the product-level Teams licence requirement, while the notes preserve the gap about the new policy.
claims.quote: Except for joining Teams meetings anonymously, each user in your organization must have a Teams license before they can use Teams.

claims.claim: The announced path is Teams admin center > Meetings > Meeting policies > policy > Recording & transcription > Who can record and transcribe.
claims.quote: A new Who can record and transcribe policy control will be available in the Recording & transcription section of the applicable Teams meeting policy in the Teams admin center.

claims.where: controls[0].api; controls[0].note; Governance controls; Open questions
claims.claim: Automation, including a PowerShell parameter, is not yet documented for the new role-restriction policy.
claims.quote: Searched: "Who can record and transcribe" "policy" "PowerShell" organizers. Searched the fetched Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy reference for record, transcri, organizer and presenter; read meeting-recording. No parameter or other automation for the new role restriction was documented.

claims.claim: Meeting recording is configured at Teams admin center > Meetings > Meeting policies > policy > Meeting recording.
claims.quote:
In the left navigation of the Teams admin center, go to Meetings > Meeting policies.
Select an existing policy or create a new one.
Turn the Meeting recording toggle On or Off.

claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policy name> -AllowCloudRecording $true enables recording for the specified meeting policy.
claims.quote: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity "Your Policy Name" -AllowCloudRecording $true

claims.claim: Transcription is configured at Teams admin center > Meetings > Meeting policies > policy > Transcription.
claims.quote:
In the left navigation of the Teams admin center, go to Meetings > Meeting policies.
Select the policy that you want to edit or create a new one.
Toggle Transcription On or Off.

claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policy name> -AllowTranscription $true enables transcription for the specified meeting policy.
claims.quote: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity "Your Policy Name" -AllowTranscription $true

claims.claim: The existing transcription toggle is both a per-organiser and a per-user availability policy.
claims.quote: Transcription is both a per-organizer and per-user policy setting. For meetings and events to include transcripts, the organizer must have this setting turned on. The user who starts the recording or transcript must also have this setting turned on.

claims.claim: The template control is at Teams admin center > Meetings > Meeting templates > Add > Recording & transcription > Who can record.
claims.quote:
In the Teams admin center, expand Meetings and select Meeting templates.
2. Select Add.

Recording & transcription
Who can record | Specifies whether meetings can be recorded by organizers and co-organizers only or by organizers, co-organizers, and presenters.

claims.claim: No setter is documented for the Who can record option within a custom meeting template.
claims.quote: Searched: "Set-CsTeamsMeetingTemplateConfiguration" "Who"; Teams custom meeting template "Microsoft Graph" update options recording. Read create-custom-meeting-template and Get-CsTeamsMeetingTemplateConfiguration, which documents a read-only configuration. No template-option setter found.

claims.claim: The Purview label creation path reaches Control who can record and transcribe through the label scope and Protect Teams meetings and chats selection.
claims.quote:
On the Settings for Teams meetings and chats page, choose the following values:

Select Control who can record and transcribe and choose Organizers and co-organizers from the dropdown list.
claims.fix: Include the intervening wizard page heading: 'Solutions > Information protection > Labels > Create a label > Define the scope for this label > Choose protection settings for types of items you selected > Protect Teams meetings and chats > Settings for Teams meetings and chats > Control who can record and transcribe'. The existing note already names this page; no different selection is required. Source: https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoftteams/configure-meetings-sensitive-protection.

claims.claim: Security & Compliance PowerShell supports Set-Label -Identity <label name> -TeamsWhoCanRecord <value> to control recording roles.
claims.quote:
The TeamsWhoCanRecord parameter controls who can record Teams meetings. Valid values are:

- Organizer
- Coorganizers
- Presenters
- $null (blank): Users configure this setting themselves in the Teams app.

claims.claim: The sensitivity-label procedure selects Files & other data assets, Emails and Meetings in the label's scope.
claims.quote: On the Define the scope for this label page, make sure Files & other data assets, Emails, and Meetings are selected.

claims.claim: The recording-availability setting needed to prevent meetings and events being recorded entirely cannot be applied through a sensitivity label.
claims.quote: This setting applies to the people or groups that you specify, but can't be applied through a meeting template or sensitivity label.

claims.claim: The recording-availability setting needed to prevent meetings and events being recorded entirely cannot be applied through a meeting template.
claims.quote: If you need to prevent meetings and events from being recorded entirely, you must use the recording policies in the Teams admin center.

claims.claim: A sensitivity label's Who can record and transcribe option does not take effect in Meet Now meetings.
claims.quote:
The following meeting options won't take effect for a Meet Now meeting:

- Who can record and transcribe

claims.claim: The new centrally managed policy applies to meetings organised by users assigned that policy.
claims.quote: This provides a centrally managed default or enforced restriction for meetings organized by users assigned the policy, reducing the need for per-meeting configuration.

claims.claim: Custom meeting policies can target selected users or groups instead of changing the Global policy.
claims.quote: To apply changes to all users in your organization who don't have an existing policy assignment, use the Global policy. To exclude certain users from the global policy, create and assign a custom meeting policy.

claims.claim: On with saved transcript required is an existing Copilot policy setting.
claims.quote: The only Copilot policy setting that you can enforce is On with saved transcript required. The other settings create a default that your organizers can change.
